column1: # Names of vtable slots (re5dx9.exe, Steam 2023). A name given to (class, slot) applies to that slot in the class and
# in every class derived from it: each override is named <its class>::<name> in Functions.tsv and in Ghidra, and
# RE::VFUNC::<class>::<name> = slot (reachable from the derived classes too) is generated for REL::InvokeVFunc.
# signature: C++ type without `this` (all slots are __thiscall). Tags in note as in Names.tsv.
